force_scale_note: 2026-09-17: switched from the auto quality-gated stance detector (which found no qualifying window for either side -- AB08's only near-miss, NOEXO_SLJ_R_8, was correctly rejected as implausible at 1.62x body weight) to manually-selected stance windows per side, picked visually via code/expt_temp/Insole_vertical_force_calib_window/select_stance_windows.py (4 trials/side accepted, consistently 1.4-1.7x body weight across independent trials -- a real, repeatable hardware bias, not noise -- see AB08_manual_stance_selections.csv/AB08_manual_calibration.json in that folder). Verified against real marker peak GRF: raw insole over-read landing peaks by 40-60%; this gain brings it to -1 to -9% -- the clearest win of any subject.
rotation_force_note: Matches the tuned value in the upstream PILOT_OOP_BASE_PY repo for AB08 -- blends the translational horizontal-GRF estimate 50/50 with the angular-momentum-rate (H-dot) moment-balance estimate. See framework_processor.py's module docstring.
